ranking: Direct condition carriers are already on main. Early field forwarding is held: 1.38x operation CPU gain but +16.4% whole-compiler instructions. The conservative late policy misses the program module because its established phases consume the work bound.
Next codegen route: reuse field identities inside existing per-function access/SSA analysis rather than spending a new global phase budget. No implementation or speedup is claimed.

Larger structural alternatives: origin-aware private dense arrays inside managed images, or immutable AOT metadata tables for first-eval type/signature preparation. Both need representation/ABI design and semantic proof.
limits: Exclusive sample groups from matched compiler wall windows are not whole-run percentages or per-function speedups. J snapshots are inclusive and cannot be summed with exclusive samples. J diagnostics timeout and are not conformance passes; the unchanged RegExp literal timeout received 284.09 CPU seconds near its original 300 s wall limit.
